null_means: not established by the reviewed sources, not zero

scope_discrepancy.note: Admissions and UAIR publish different undergraduate totals; definitions or timing were not reconciled. Use UAIR for total enrollment, not as a measured daily dining population.

on_campus_residents.use: Residential population is more directly relevant to recurring dining demand than total enrollment.

campus_meals.note: Program-wide descriptive meal volume; not a count of unique students and not limited to the four dining commons.
